His gaze lingered on them for a moment before returning to Dexter.
"Why would I care if you are innocent?"
Before Dexter could reply —
"BOOM!"
The assassin kicked off the hood.
The already-crushed metal exploded beneath his feet, sending chunks of steel flying in every direction.
Like a bolt of lightning, he shot straight toward Dexter as a sonic boom echoed behind him.
The twin swords whistled through the air, aiming directly for Dexter’s neck.
The blue lightning on their edges screamed with a high-pitched whine.

chapters.title: Chapter 40 | Spatial Cleave!
paragraphs: Fast.
Far faster than any opponent Dexter had fought before. The assassin closed the distance in the blink of an eye. One moment he was on the hood. The next moment he was right in front of Dexter’s face.
Without hesitation, Dexter waved his hand.
A long black saber instantly appeared in his grip. It materialized from his system inventory in a flash of light, the weight settling into his palm as if it had always been there.
The Type-3 Macro Splicing Saber.
He had kept it inside his system inventory ever since receiving it. Never drawn it
Now, for the first time...
He finally drew it in real combat.
"CLANG!"
Steel collided with steel.
A powerful shockwave erupted from the impact. A visible ring of force expanded outward, kicking up dust and debris from the highway surface.
The asphalt beneath Dexter’s feet cracked apart. Spider webs of fractures spread in every direction.
The shattered remains of the SUV were pushed backward several meters, scraping across the road with a metallic screech.
The assassin’s eyes narrowed behind his mask.
"Your strength is impressive. It’s no wonder you are confident."
Dexter didn’t answer.
Instead, he twisted his wrist and slashed horizontally. The black saber cut through the air with speed that it left a dark afterimage.
The assassin blocked with one blade while counterattacking with the other.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Three rapid collisions rang across the highway. Each one louder than the last. Each one more violent.
Sparks scattered like fireworks. They flew in every direction, landing on the asphalt and burning tiny black marks into the surface.
Nearby abandoned vehicles shook from the force. One car’s windows shattered from the pressure alone.
Blue lightning collided repeatedly with the dark steel of the Macro Splicing Saber. Each impact sent arcs of electricity crawling along the blade’s edge.
Although Dexter managed to block every strike, each collision forced him another step backward. His feet slid across the asphalt as his arms absorbed the brunt of every hit.
"Bang!"
His arms became numb as his feet dug trenches into the asphalt. Two long grooves trailed behind him, marking every step he had been forced to take.
"So this is the strength of a Superhuman..." Dexter muttered through gritted teeth.
The gap in raw cultivation still existed.
Suddenly—
His enhanced hearing picked up another sound.
A faint metallic click.
Someone was reloading a sniper rifle.
Dexter’s face changed instantly.
There was still another assassin!
Without hesitation, he activated Flame Burst.
Boom!
Flames exploded beneath his feet.
His speed increased fivefold.
His figure disappeared from before the superhuman assassin.
The masked man swung instinctively—
His blades sliced through empty air.
At that same moment...
Nearly three hundred meters away...
A sniper squeezed the trigger.
Bang!
The bullet crossed the battlefield in an instant.
Its target... Selene.
Still inside the SUV, she had no way of seeing the attack coming.
Dexter’s eyes widened.
He swung his saber toward the incoming bullet.
Too late.
The projectile had already reached her.
For a split second...
His heart nearly stopped.
Then—
A brilliant violet barrier suddenly bloomed around the girls.
BOOM!
The sniper bullet struck the barrier head-on.
Ripples spread across the protective shield.
But...
It didn’t break.
Not even a crack appeared.
Dexter let out a long breath of relief.
The Type-Three Protective Amulet had activated.
As long as the barrier remained intact...
The girls would be safe.
The sniper fired again.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Three more anti-mana rounds slammed into the barrier.
Each impact created massive ripples...
Yet the shield remained completely unharmed.
The assassin standing opposite Dexter frowned beneath his mask.
"So they have protective artifacts..."
His killing intent intensified.
"If that’s the case..."
"I’ll kill you first."
Blue lightning suddenly exploded around his body. It wasn’t just on his blades anymore. It covered his entire form. Crackling arcs of electricity danced across his arms, his chest, his legs.
Crack!
Crack!
Crack!
Bolts of electricity crawled across the ground beneath his feet. The asphalt blackened wherever the lightning touched.
His aura surged explosively as he activated his Thunder talent and disappeared into a streak of lightning. He was way faster this time as tranformed into a streak of lightning.
Dexter’s enhanced vision barely managed to follow the blur. He saw a streak of blue light moving toward him with insane speed.
He wang d to dodge but his body was simply too slow.
Without hesitation, he activated Flame Burst bloodline skill.
"Bang!"
Crimson flames erupted beneath his feet as his speed increased by 500%!
Just as he moved —
Slash!
One of the lightning blades grazed across his chest. The edge cut through his shirt like it was made of paper. The fabric split open instantly, revealing the skin beneath.
Blood trickled down his chest but it was kbkyrwt a superficial injury.
But the lightning energy embedded in the cut sent tiny shocks through his nerves.
Dexter’s expression darkened.
Even after dodging...
He had still been injured. The assassin was simply too fast. His attacks covered too much area. Even when Dexter moved, the blade’s reach was long enough to catch him.
The assassin smirked beneath his mask.
"Your reaction speed is impressive."
"But your cultivation is too low."
"The gap between Meta Human and super human is as vast as the ocean. You cannot possible hope to bridge the gap between the Awakening Realm and the Superhuman Realm."
He was right. The difference between the two realms was vast.
At the awakening realm, each level up increases inches strength by 25 stats across all attributes.
But for Super human realm, each level up is a whole 50 stat points in each attribute!
Every physical attribute was elevated to a completely different level upon entering the Superhuman Realm.
Dexter tightened his grip on the Macro Splicing Saber.
Without hesitation he immediately activated Scorching Fury.
"Bang!"
A wave of heat burst from his body as the air around him shimmered and trembled.
His muscles swelled as tremendous strength coursed through every fiber of his being.
He could feel the power flooding through him like lava.
His combat power instantly rose by eighty percent.
A crimson aura surrounded him. It flickered like flame, dancing across his skin and along the length of his blade.
The assassin laughed.
"Good."
"I was hoping you weren’t weak."
In the distance, terrified civilians had already fled the highway. Cars sat abandoned in long rows. Some had their doors still hanging open where their owners had fled without thinking.
Some people hid behind abandoned vehicles, peeking over the hoods with wide, frightened eyes.
Others recorded the battle with trembling hands. Phone cameras shook violently as they tried to capture the superhuman clash.
Emergency sirens echoed faintly from afar. Getting closer. Someone had already called the authorities.
But neither fighter cared.
The assassin suddenly smirked.
"Now, let’s battle for real!"
The next instant —
The assassin thrust both swords toward the sky.
Lightning suddenly gathered as the morning sky darkened.
Crackling arcs of lightning danced between the two blades as a terrifying pressure spread throughout the battlefield.
The fleeing civilians looked back in horror.
"What is that?"
"Is that... lightning?"
"Heaven..."
The assassin roared.
"Thunder God’s Slash!"
The accumulated lightning poured into both sabers. The blades became blindingly bright as he slashed directly at Dexter r with unbelievable speed.
Dexter’s pupils contracted.
He instinctively knew he couldn’t block this attack through brute force alone. If he tried to meet it head-on with a simple slash, he would be cut in half along with his blade.
He took in a deep breathe and he face turned cold.
Pouring mana into the Macro Splicing Saber as he activated one of the skills of the Type 3 weapon.
Spatial Cleave!

chapters.title: Chapter 41 | Killing Four Assassins
paragraphs: Spatial Cleave.
Dexter swung his blade at the thunder attack.
A compressed crescent-shaped slash, nearly two meters tall, shot forward silently with insane speed.
There was no explosion or even a rumble, just a clean, perfect arc of cutting force that moved through the air like a blade through water.
The attack silently split the air itself. A faint trail of distorted space followed its path, like heat rising from hot pavement.
The two techniques collided.
BOOOOOOM!!
A deafening explosion echoed across the entire highway. It shattered every remaining window on every car within a hundred-meter radius.

Lightning exploded outward in every direction. Arcs of blue electricity shot across the road like angry snakes. They struck cars, guardrails, and light poles, leaving scorch marks wherever they touched.
Space distorted violently. The air around the collision point bent and warped.
The surrounding asphalt cracked apart for dozens of meters. Massive chunks of road surface flipped into the air. A crater formed beneath the impact point, deepening with every passing millisecond.
For a brief moment...
Neither attack gave way.
The lightning pushed forward. The spatial slash pushed back. The two forces ground against each other in a contest of pure destruction.
Then —
A sharp cracking sound echoed.
The lightning slash shattered. It broke apart like glass hit by a stone. Fragments of blue energy scattered and dissolved into the air.
Dexter’s Spatial Cleave continued forward, tearing through the remaining thunder. The crescent of distorted space surged ahead with undiminished power.
The assassin’s eyes widened.
Impossible!
He had poured everything into that attack and it was his most powerful technique.
But it had actually been overpowered.
He hurriedly crossed both sabers before him as the spatial Cleave struck.
CRACK!
Both sabers shattered into countless fragments. The metal exploded outward. Shards of steel flew in every direction like shrapnel.
The assassin froze.
For a heartbeat...
Everything became silent. The world stopped.
Then a thin crimson line appeared across the center of his body.
His eyes slowly widened in disbelief.
Before he could finish his words, his body split cleanly into two halves as they fell in opposite directions.
Blood sprayed across the ruined highway in a wide arc. The hot red liquid splattered across the asphalt, the guardrails, and the nearby abandoned cars.
Both halves collapsed onto the ground with a dull thud.
Dexter remained standing, breathing heavily. Sweat rolled down his forehead and into his eyes. His arms trembled from exhaustion.
Nearly half the mana inside his body had vanished from that single strike. Spatial Cleave was powerful, but its cost was enormous.
Just when he sighed in relief.
He remembered there was a fourth assassin.
At this moment, a blur appeared before the SUV. The fourth assassin had given up on using sniper and rushed in personally.
Inside the vehicle, Mira, Selene, and Lyra remained protected by the shimmering violet barrier created by the Type-3 Protective Amulet.
The assassin suddenly raised his sword high into the air.
Golden flames erupted around the blade as he swung downward with all his strength.
"BOOM!"
The flaming sword slammed against the violet barrier as a shockwave blasted outward, sending dust and debris flying in every direction.
The shield rippled violently. Countless waves spread across its surface like ripples in a pond as the color dimmed a little but it didn’t break.
The assassin frowned. His brow furrowed behind his mask.
He attacked again and again and again but the shield actually held.
Golden flames exploded repeatedly against the barrier. Each strike sent another shockwave across the highway.
Yet the violet shield merely trembled before returning to normal each time.
Inside the barrier, the girls watched with cold expressions on their faces. Mira’s jaw was clenched. Selene’s hands were balled into fists. Lyra’s eyes were wide behind her glasses.
But the girls weren’t panicked at all. They were filled with rage and anger.
In their prime, a Level 5 Superhuman was nothing in their eyes. Before their injuries, they were insanely strong and could handle anyone below the peak Super Human realm..
They were monsters who had faced monsters and enemies that would make this assassin tremble with fear.
They had once fought monsters that could destroy cities.
And now...
Now a low-rank hero was actually showing off and threatening to kill them. A Level 5 Superhuman. Someone they would have swatted aside like a fly in their prime.
Moreover, they lacked the strength to defend themselves. They couldn’t fight. They couldn’t run. They could only sit and watch as someone attacked them like helpless prey.
This made the three girls really, really angry.
The Type-3 Protective Amulet truly possessed defensive power capable of blocking attacks from Peak Superhuman experts
As long as the barrier remained active...
The assassin was about to strike again.
But —
A streak of crimson flames shot across the battlefield.
The second assassin sensed the danger and immediately abandoned the barrier and he turned just in time to block.
CLANG!
The Macro Splicing Saber collided with the flaming sword.
Sparks exploded everywhere. Crimson sparks from Dexter’s flame-enhanced blade.
Golden sparks from the assassin’s burning sword. They mixed in the air like two colors of fire dancing together.
The force of the collision pushed both men backward several meters. Their feet carved grooves into the asphalt as they skidded apart.
The assassin smirked beneath his mask. His eyes glittered with amusement.
"Because you killed Thunder Blade, you assume you can do the same to me?"
He twirled his sword casually. Golden flames spiraled around the blade in elegant patterns.
Golden flames erupted around his body. His entire figure became enveloped in blazing fire. The heat was intense. Oppressive. It radiated outward in waves.
"C-Rank Talent..."
Golden Flame Body.
The temperature around him rose instantly and the air shimmered.
Even from several meters away, Dexter could feel the heat pressing against his skin. It was like standing next to an open furnace.
Dexter narrowed his eyes.
Another elemental talent.
And this time he was a Level 5 Superhuman. Two full levels above the first assassin.
This battle...
...was becoming far more dangerous than he had anticipated.

paragraphs: Golden flames roared around the assassin like a blazing cloak.
Dexter tightened his grip on the Macro Splicing Saber.
This assassin was even more dangerous than the first.
His mana was still only half full after using Spatial Cleave.
Scorching Fury had already been active for nearly a minute and he had activated Flame Burst Constantly.
The techniques put tremendous strain on his muscles. Every second it remained active, his body endured more stress.
He couldn’t afford a drawn-out battle. Not against a Level 5 Superhuman or with half his mana gone.
The assassin grinned.
"So you’re the one Lord Voss wants dead."
"I expected someone stronger."
The name meant nothing to Dexter. Lord Voss. He filed it away for later. If he survived.
Before Dexter could reply —
"Boom!"
The assassin vanished. One moment he was standing there, wrapped in golden flames. The next moment, he was gone.
Golden flames exploded beneath his feet as he appeared behind Dexter almost instantly.
His flaming sword descended toward Dexter’s back as he slashed at his neck.
Dexter reacted purely on instinct activating Flame Burst to raise his agility as he spun around and raised his saber.
Clang!
The collision sent sparks flying in every direction. Dexter’s entire arm went numb from the impact as he was blasted backward.
He flew through the air for several meters before crashing into an abandoned sedan parked across the highway.
"Bang!"

Dexter’s back slammed against the car’s hood. The metal crumpled beneath his weight. The windshield shattered. The entire vehicle slid backward several meters before smashing into the guardrail with a screech of metal.
Its alarm immediately began blaring. A loud, piercing wail that added to the chaos of the battlefield.
Dexter barely had time to steady himself. He pushed himself off the crumpled hood and raised his saber.
The assassin was already in front of him.
His speed was frightening. He had crossed the distance in the time it took Dexter to blink.
The flaming blade thrust toward Dexter’s abdomen like a venomous snake.
Dexter eyes suddenly turned vicious and instead of dodging he stepped forward into the blade.
"Shhhk!"
The assassin’s eyes widened behind his mask as he hadn’t expected for Dexter to step towards his own death.
The blade pierced straight into Dexter’s side.
The flaming sword slid underneath his ribs with a sickening ease. The heat cauterized the wound instantly, preventing excessive bleeding but sending blinding pain through every nerve in his body.
Shhk!
Pain shot through Dexter’s body as his vision blurred and his knees buckled.
The assassin grinned viciously. The blade was buried in Dexter’s side. One pull and the intestines would follow.
"You’ve lost."
But the smile on Dexter’s face only widened.
"...Got you."

Dexter’s left hand shot forward, gripping the assassin’s sword arm with terrifying force.

Dexter opened his mouth.

"Flame Demon’s Wrath."
A torrent of demonic fire erupted from his mouth.
BOOOOOOM!!
The crimson-gold inferno engulfed the assassin completely as it wrapped around the assassin’s body like a living thing, seeking every gap in his defense.
The flames were crimson at their core and gold at their edges. They burned with a heat that melted the asphalt into liquid. The air itself ignited. Oxygen became fuel.

The man roared in pain as he desperately unleashed his own Golden Flame talent. His body blazed with golden fire. A blazing golden barrier formed around him, a sphere of protective flame that he poured every ounce of his mana into maintaining.
The two flames clashed violently. Crimson-gold against pure gold. Demon fire against human talent.
For several seconds...
The golden flames resisted and the barrier held. The assassin’s C-Rank talent was strong enough to temporarily withstand the demonic fire’s assault.
But only temporarily.

The demonic fire devoured everything in its path. It ate through the golden barrier like acid through paper. It consumed the golden flames and grew stronger from them. It fed on the assassin’s own energy and turned it against him.

His flesh burned away almost instantly. The golden barrier collapsed. The flames reached deep into his skull and feasted.
His face fell off and liquidfy against the demonic flames. His muscles dripped to the ground and his bones blackened and within seconds...

Silence.

Combined with the wound in his abdomen...
His body was reaching its limit.
He looked down at the sword still embedded in his side.
Grimacing, he gripped the hilt. His fingers wrapped around the hilt and he dqueezed tight.
With one swift motion —
Shhk!
He pulled the blade free. The metal slid out with a wet sound. Blood followed immediately. It poured from the wound in a steady stream, running down his side and dripping onto the ground.
But almost immediately...
The regenerative power of his Origin Bloodline and the Slaughter Demon Body technique activated as his cells started to regenerate and heal rapidly.

chapters.title: Chapter 43 | Extract C Rank Talent: Thunder & Golden Flames
paragraphs: The Eternal Buddha Endurance Scripture and his Origin Bloodline began working simultaneously.
Warm energy spread through his body.
The torn flesh around the wound slowly wriggled before beginning to close.
Although the injury wasn’t healed completely, the bleeding quickly stopped.
Dexter tore a strip from his ruined shirt and wrapped it tightly around his abdomen before letting out a long breath.
"I really need to stop getting stabbed..."
He gave a bitter smile.
This battle had shown him just how dangerous the Superhuman Realm truly was. If he wanted to survive more assassination attempts, then he would need to get stronger.
The fastest way to grow stronger is to level up. And to level up one needs to head into dungeons to kill monsters and level up quickly.
He staggered towards the corpses of the assassins and activated his second system.
"Extract!"
A faint golden light enveloped the corpse. The light pulsed twice before a translucent blue notification appeared before Dexter’s eyes.
[Extracted +5 Strength, +6 Agility]
The numbers flowed into his body like warm water. He could feel the changes immediately. His muscles tightened slightly. His reflexes sharpened. The change wasn’t dramatic, but it was real.
He moved to the second corpse. The assassin whose throat he had pierced with the curving needle. The man’s neck was still stained dark with dried blood.
"Extract!"
[Extracted +5 Mana, +6 Agility, +5 Strength, +6 Physique]
More energy flowed into him. This time the sensation was stronger. His mana pool expanded slightly. His body felt sturdier. More resilient. Like someone had reinforced his bones with steel.
He moved to the third corpse. The first Superhuman assassin. The one he had cut in half with Spatial Cleave. The two halves lay side by side on the asphalt, separated by a pool of darkening blood.
"Extract!"
[Extracted + C-Rank Golden Flame, +3 Strength, +7 Agility]
Dexter’s eyes widened.
He actually extracted their talents too?

The Golden Flame ability surged into his body like a wave of liquid fire. It settled deep inside his core, nestling beside his existing abilities like a new addition to a family. He could feel the flame’s potential. Its heat. Its hunger. It was a C-Rank talent, which was considered above average for most awakeners.
He had just stolen a dead man’s talent.
The implications were staggering.

Finally, he moved to the fourth corpse. Or what remained of it. The charred skeleton of the second Superhuman assassin. The bones were black and brittle. They crumbled slightly when Dexter knelt beside them.
"Extract!"
[Extracted + C-Rank Thunder Manipulation, +7 Strength, +1 Agility, +3 Mana, +4 Physique]

A crackling surge of electrical energy raced through his body. Blue sparks danced across his fingertips for a brief moment before fading. The Thunder Manipulation talent embedded itself beside the Golden Flame ability, creating a small storm of competing energies inside his core.
Dexter stared at his hands.
He now possessed two additional C-Rank talents.
Golden Flame.
Thunder Manipulation.
Combined with his existing abilities...
His combat potential had increased dramatically.
But the excitement was short-lived.
He suddenly heard sirens in the distance.
Woo — Woo — Woo —
The sound was faint at first. Barely audible over the ambient noise of the city. But it grew louder with each passing second. More sirens joined the chorus. From multiple directions.
Dexter’s expression shifted instantly.
More than a dozen police vehicles sped toward the highway from both directions.
Behind them came several armored response trucks belonging to the Hero Association.
Their flashing lights illuminated the battlefield.
Within moments, the entire highway was surrounded.
Officers quickly aimed their weapons toward the scene.
When they saw four masked corpses lying on the ground and only one bloodied young man still standing...
Every one of them froze.
"...What happened here?"
One officer muttered in disbelief.
Another looked at the assassin whose body had been sliced perfectly into two.
His eyes widened.
"That... wasn’t done by an explosion."
"It was one slash."
Nearby, another investigator examined the burned face corpse.
"There isn’t even enough face left for identification..."

The surrounding civilians, who had hidden behind abandoned vehicles, slowly emerged once they heard the commotion stop. The battle was over. The danger had passed. Police and heroes were on the scene.

People stepped out from behind cars, bushes, and guardrails. Some were shaking. Some were crying. Some were recording on their phones despite the earlier destruction of most devices close to the battle.
A woman holding a child hurried toward the nearest officer.
"Officer! Officer! There was a battle!"
"We saw fire and lightning!"
"It was terrifying!"
An elderly man approached another officer.
"I’ve never seen anything like it."
"The whole highway shook."
"I thought it was an earthquake at first."
More witnesses gathered. Each one tried to explain what they had seen. Their accounts were fragmented. Confused. Contradictory.
Some mentioned a man with a black sword.
Others mentioned blue lightning.
Some mentioned golden flames.
Some mentioned crimson fire.
None of them could provide a clear description.
Dexter remained calm despite the dozens of eyes fixed on him.

He had already changed into a fresh set of clothes from his system inventory while the police were busy securing the scene. Apart from the bandage wrapped around his abdomen beneath his shirt, there was nothing to suggest he had just fought two Superhuman assassins and killed them too.
The lead investigator stopped before him.
"I’m Senior Inspector Harris of the City Police Department. I need your statement."
Dexter nodded.
"I’ll cooperate."
The investigator activated a recording device.
"Tell me exactly what happened."
Dexter took a deep breath before speaking.
"We were driving home from the hotel when the driver was suddenly shot."
His voice was steady. Measured. He allowed a slight tremor to enter his tone to sell the fear.
"I didn’t see the bullet. I just heard a sound and then... the driver’s head..."
He paused as he swallowed uncomfortably.
"The car started swerving. I grabbed the wheel and managed to stop it beneath the bridge."
"Then several masked men attacked us."
The investigator’s eyes narrowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 44 | Investigation
paragraphs: "How many?"
"Four that I saw," Dexter said. "There might have been more."
"What happened after that?"
Dexter frowned as though recalling the terrifying scene. His brow furrowed. His hands clenched slightly.
"Before they could reach us... someone arrived."
"Someone?"
"A hero."
The officers immediately leaned closer. The word "hero" carried specific weight in their world. Heroes were licensed combatants registered with the Hero Association.
But unlicensed heroes existed too. Powerful awakeners who operated outside the system. Some were vigilantes. Some were simply private citizens who intervened when danger arose.
"Did you recognize the hero?"
Dexter slowly shook his head.
"No."
"He wore a black mask and a long coat. I couldn’t see his face."
"He moved too fast."
"I only remember seeing flashes of fire and sword light."
"The battle lasted less than a minute."
"By the time it was over... the assassins were already dead."
The investigator studied Dexter’s face carefully. His eyes searched for signs of deception.
Dexter met his gaze without flinching.

He had practiced controlling his expressions during his time with the Ashford family. Years of hiding his true feelings behind a neutral mask had given him near-perfect control over his facial muscles.
The investigator asked one final question.
"Did the hero tell you his name?"
Dexter shook his head again.
"No."
"He only told us to stay inside the barrier."
"Then he left."
"Immediately."
"I wanted to thank him, but he disappeared before anyone could react."
The investigator held his gaze for a moment longer before sighing. He stopped the recording. The red light vanished.
"We’ll investigate further."
"If we identify the hero, the Hero Association will certainly reward him."
Dexter merely nodded.
"I hope so."
He kept his expression neutral. Inside, he felt a spark of satisfaction.
His story was airtight. The battlefield supported his account. The level of destruction was far beyond what an Awakening Realm cultivator should be capable of.
Neither pointed toward a recently awakened young man.
Both pointed toward a powerful, unidentified hero.
The police would search for this phantom hero. They would waste time and resources chasing a ghost.
Meanwhile, Dexter would remain hidden in plain sight.
The investigator glanced toward the armored police vehicle where the three girls were resting.
"We’ll also need statements from your wives."
"They were present during the attack."
Dexter’s expression softened.
"I understand, Inspector... but I’d rather you leave them alone."
"They’ve already suffered enough."
"They’re all disabled."
"One is blind.
"One is deaf and mute."
"And one is completely paralyzed."
"They’ve only just begun recovering from the trauma of the previous attack."
"If they’re questioned right now..."
"They’ll only relive today’s incident all over again."
"I can answer anything you need."
The investigator looked toward the medical vehicle where his wives are being examined.
He saw Mira sitting silently in her wheelchair.
Selene’s face was pale and blind
Lyra sat beside them with her head lowered, clutching her phone tightly.
The three girls genuinely looked traumatized.
After a long moment, the investigator sighed.
"...Very well."
"We won’t question them today."
"But if this investigation requires it later, we’ll have to ask for their cooperation."
Dexter inclined his head.
"Thank you."
Inside, he breathed a sigh of relief.

As the investigation continued, several officers began questioning nearby witnesses. Their statements were recorded and cross-referenced. Each witness told a slightly different version of the same event, which was normal. Human memory was unreliable, especially under stress.
One of the younger policemen suddenly looked toward Dexter. His eyes widened. His mouth opened slightly. He took a step forward.
"Wait..."
"You’re that guy, aren’t you?"
Dexter turned toward him with a politely confused expression.
"The one from the news."
The officer snapped his fingers as he tried to recall the details.
"The bastard son of the Ashford Family..."
"...who married three disabled girls."
Several officers immediately recognized him as well. Murmurs spread through the group like wildfire.
"I remember him."
"The Hero Association publicly compensated him after his house was attacked."
"That’s right. The monster attack. It was all over the news."
"Poor guy."
"Now assassins are after him too?"
"What did he do to piss someone off this badly?"
Whispers spread among the gathered crowd. Not just among the officers. The civilians who had gathered nearby also began to recognize him. Phones were raised. Cameras clicked.

Some looked at Dexter sympathetically. Their eyes carried genuine pity. They saw a young man who had been dealt a terrible hand in life. Born into a wealthy family that rejected him. Married to three women who couldn’t care for themselves. Attacked by monsters. And now targeted by assassins.
Others simply shook their heads.
"What terrible luck..."
"The poor man just can’t catch a break."
"First monsters. Now assassins. What’s next?"
"Someone up there really doesn’t like him."
Dexter smiled awkwardly but didn’t respond. He rubbed the back of his neck. He looked down at his feet. He played the part of the embarrassed, unfortunate victim perfectly.
The less attention on his true strength, the better.
Fortunately, no one had managed to record the battle clearly.
The violent shockwaves from the clashes had shattered the phones of everyone standing nearby.
Those farther away had only captured blurry flashes of lightning and fire from hundreds of meters away.
The videos circulating online were nothing more than indistinct streaks of light.
No one could identify the mysterious swordsman.
After nearly an hour, the police finished collecting evidence.
The four assassin corpses were loaded into specialized containment vehicles.
The damaged vehicle was towed away.

Fragments of the shattered weapons were carefully sealed as evidence. The broken pieces of the first assassin’s twin lightning blades were collected in a special mana-dampening container. The melted remnants of the second assassin’s flaming sword were scraped off the asphalt and stored separately.
Senior Inspector Harris walked over once more. His trench coat fluttered slightly in the morning breeze. His expression was grave.
"Mr. Dexter."
"We’ll arrange transportation."
"Given today’s incident, it isn’t safe for you to travel alone."
Dexter nodded.
"Thank you."

A heavily armored police vehicle escorted them all the way home. The vehicle was reinforced with mana-infused plating and equipped with multiple defensive systems. It could withstand attacks from Superhuman-level threats.

Two patrol cars led the convoy while another followed behind. Their sirens blared continuously, clearing traffic from their path. Drivers pulled aside as the procession passed, their faces pressed against their windows in curiosity.
The entire journey passed without incident.
Inside the vehicle, silence filled the compartment.
The girls remained unusually quiet.
Several minutes later, Mira finally broke the silence.
"...Are you hurt?"
Her voice was softer than usual.
Dexter looked toward her and smiled.
"I’m fine."
"You saw me, It was only a few scratches."
Mira frowned but didn’t reply.
She didn’t believe him. Selene lowered her head.
Although she couldn’t see him earlier, she had heard the sounds of battle.
Every explosion...
Every collision...
Every scream...
She knew how dangerous that fight had been.
Lyra quickly typed on her phone.
The AI voice spoke.
"Are you really okay?"
Dexter looked at the three worried faces before chuckling.
"I told you, I am tougher than I look."
Only then did the tense atmosphere inside the vehicle ease slightly.
Even so...
The three girls secretly resolved to become stronger.
If they had been stronger today...
Dexter wouldn’t have had to risk his life protecting them again.
But Dexter’s mind was elsewhere.
[Ding! 10,000 Times Investment System]

"We’ll investigate further."
"If we identify the hero, the Hero Association will certainly reward him."
Dexter merely nodded.
"I hope so."
He kept his expression neutral.
Inside, he felt a spark of satisfaction.
His story was airtight.
The battlefield supported his account.
The level of destruction was far beyond what an Awakening Realm cultivator should be capable of.
Neither pointed toward a recently awakened young man.
Both pointed toward a powerful, unidentified hero.
The police would search for this phantom hero.
They would waste time and resources chasing a ghost.
Meanwhile, Dexter would remain hidden in plain sight.
The investigator glanced toward the armored police vehicle where the three girls were resting.
"We’ll also need statements from your wives."
"They were present during the attack."
Dexter’s expression softened.
"I understand, Inspector... but I’d rather you leave them alone."
"They’ve already suffered enough."
"They’re all disabled."
"One is blind.
"One is deaf and mute."
"And one is completely paralyzed."
"They’ve only just begun recovering from the trauma of the previous attack."
"If they’re questioned right now..."
"They’ll only relive today’s incident all over again."
"I can answer anything you need."
The investigator looked toward the medical vehicle where his wives are being examined.
He saw Mira sitting silently in her wheelchair.
Selene’s face was pale and blind
Lyra sat beside them with her head lowered, clutching her phone tightly.
The three girls genuinely looked traumatized.
After a long moment, the investigator sighed.
"...Very well."
"We won’t question them today."
"But if this investigation requires it later, we’ll have to ask for their cooperation."
Dexter inclined his head.
"Thank you."
Inside, he breathed a sigh of relief.
As the investigation continued, several officers began questioning nearby witnesses.
Their statements were recorded and cross-referenced.
Each witness told a slightly different version of the same event, which was normal.
Human memory was unreliable, especially under stress.
One of the younger policemen suddenly looked toward Dexter.
His eyes widened.
His mouth opened slightly.
He took a step forward.
"Wait..."
"You’re that guy, aren’t you?"
Dexter turned toward him with a politely confused expression.
"The one from the news."
The officer snapped his fingers as he tried to recall the details.
"The bastard son of the Ashford Family..."
"...who married three disabled girls."
Several officers immediately recognized him as well.
Murmurs spread through the group like wildfire.
"I remember him."
"The Hero Association publicly compensated him after his house was attacked."
"That’s right.
The monster attack.
It was all over the news."
"Poor guy."
"Now assassins are after him too?"
"What did he do to piss someone off this badly?"
Whispers spread among the gathered crowd.
Not just among the officers.
The civilians who had gathered nearby also began to recognize him.
Phones were raised.
Cameras clicked.
Some looked at Dexter sympathetically.
Their eyes carried genuine pity.
They saw a young man who had been dealt a terrible hand in life.
Born into a wealthy family that rejected him.
Married to three women who couldn’t care for themselves.
Attacked by monsters.
And now targeted by assassins.
Others simply shook their heads.
"What terrible luck..."
"The poor man just can’t catch a break."
"First monsters.
Now assassins.
What’s next?"
"Someone up there really doesn’t like him."
Dexter smiled awkwardly but didn’t respond.
He rubbed the back of his neck.
He looked down at his feet.
He played the part of the embarrassed, unfortunate victim perfectly.
The less attention on his true strength, the better.
Fortunately, no one had managed to record the battle clearly.
The violent shockwaves from the clashes had shattered the phones of everyone standing nearby.
Those farther away had only captured blurry flashes of lightning and fire from hundreds of meters away.
The videos circulating online were nothing more than indistinct streaks of light.
No one could identify the mysterious swordsman.
After nearly an hour, the police finished collecting evidence.
The four assassin corpses were loaded into specialized containment vehicles.
The damaged vehicle was towed away.
Fragments of the shattered weapons were carefully sealed as evidence.
The broken pieces of the first assassin’s twin lightning blades were collected in a special mana-dampening container.
The melted remnants of the second assassin’s flaming sword were scraped off the asphalt and stored separately.
Senior Inspector Harris walked over once more.
His trench coat fluttered slightly in the morning breeze.
His expression was grave.
"Mr.
Dexter."
"We’ll arrange transportation."
"Given today’s incident, it isn’t safe for you to travel alone."
Dexter nodded.
"Thank you."
A heavily armored police vehicle escorted them all the way home.
The vehicle was reinforced with mana-infused plating and equipped with multiple defensive systems.
It could withstand attacks from Superhuman-level threats.
Two patrol cars led the convoy while another followed behind.
Their sirens blared continuously, clearing traffic from their path.
Drivers pulled aside as the procession passed, their faces pressed against their windows in curiosity.
The entire journey passed without incident.
Inside the vehicle, silence filled the compartment.
The girls remained unusually quiet.
Several minutes later, Mira finally broke the silence.
"...Are you hurt?"
Her voice was softer than usual.
Dexter looked toward her and smiled.
"I’m fine."
"You saw me, It was only a few scratches."
Mira frowned but didn’t reply.
She didn’t believe him.
Selene lowered her head.
Although she couldn’t see him earlier, she had heard the sounds of battle.
Every explosion...
Every collision...
Every scream...
She knew how dangerous that fight had been.
Lyra quickly typed on her phone.
The AI voice spoke.
"Are you really okay?"
Dexter looked at the three worried faces before chuckling.
"I told you, I am tougher than I look."
Only then did the tense atmosphere inside the vehicle ease slightly.
Even so...
The three girls secretly resolved to become stronger.
If they had been stronger today...
Dexter wouldn’t have had to risk his life protecting them again.
But Dexter’s mind was elsewhere.
[Ding!
10,000 Times Investment System]

chapters.title: Chapter 46 | Diamond Rice & Promise Not To Leave
paragraphs: He opened the door and under the envy and pity of the officers, Dexter and his wives all they all went in.
The apartment finally felt like a home again.
Everything had been repaired. The window, the door, the chairs and even the cracked floor.
It was as though nothing ever happened there.
Dexter spent the next hour arranging everyone’s luggage.

He carried each bag to the appropriate room without rushing. He neatly placed Mira’s belongings beside her room, organized Selene’s clothes inside the wardrobe with precision, and helped Lyra arrange hers as well.
As he looked around the bedrooms, he scratched the back of his head.
"Two more beds..."
Three girls sharing two beds wasn’t exactly ideal. Once he earned more money, new beds would be one of the first things he purchased.
With that decided, Dexter headed into the kitchen.
He rolled up his sleeves and washed his hands. He opened the refrigerator and examined the ingredients inside. Vegetables. Eggs. Rice. Seasonings. Nothing special, but enough to work with.
He pulled out a cutting board and began slicing vegetables with practiced ease. The knife moved rhythmically against the wood as he sliced them precisely.
Soon, the aroma of freshly cooked food spread throughout the apartment, making throat dry and stomach grumble.
At that moment, a system notification rang out inside of his head.
[Ding! Congratulations! You’ve successfully prepared your first Effect Meal!]
[Name: Comfort Vegetable Fried Rice]
[Grade: 1]
[Effect: Soothes the consumer’s muscles, relieving minor fatigue and accelerating physical recovery for 30 minutes.]

[Description: A simple yet nourishing meal infused with a vast amount of mana. While its taste is slightly above, it’s effects are impressive, capable of easing sore muscle soreness and restore stamina, sooth the meridians and increase mana recovery after strenuous activity.]
The smell seeped under bedroom doors and drifted through every corner of the small living space.

Even though everyone had eaten before leaving the hotel, especially Lyra, who had consumed enough food for three people, she still wandered into the dining room with sparkling eyes the moment she smelled Dexter’s cooking. Her feet padded softly against the floor. Her nose led the way.
"...Hungry already?" Dexter laughed from the stove.
Lyra nodded without the slightest embarrassment. Her eyes were fixed on the pan where eggs sizzled in golden oil.
Mira rolled her eyes from her wheelchair.
"She’s a bottomless pit."
Selene simply smiled faintly before taking her seat at the table. She found her chair by memory and sat down gracefully.
The four of them ate breakfast together.
The moment the first bite entered their mouths, the girls froze.
A warm current flowed through their bodies like liquid sunlight. It soothed their muscles, eased their joints, and replenished their stamina.
Even the exhaustion from cultivating throughout the night and day disappeared almost instantly.
The internal soreness in Mira’s legs faded. The stiffness in Selene’s shoulders melted away. The fog in Lyra’s mind cleared.
Lyra’s eyes lit up like two burning stars.
Without hesitation, she began stuffing food into her mouth at an alarming speed. Rice disappeared in spoonfuls. Vegetables vanished between bites. She barely chewed before swallowing.
One bowl.
Two bowls.
Three bowls...
Dexter watched in amazement.
"At this point, I’m convinced your stomach is connected to another dimension."
Lyra read the words and smiled sheepishly with rice grains stuck to her cheek and continued eating.
[Ding!]
[10,000× Investment System Activated]
[Investment Target: Mira, Selene, Lyra
[Investment: You sincerely cooked for your three wives]
[Multiplier: 100× ]
[Calculating Returns...]
[Rewards Obtained:]
[Cooking Mastery has advanced.]
[Foodsmith Rank: Peak Master → Grandmaster.]
[Grandmaster Foodsmith]

[Info: You can now prepare foods capable of nourishing the body, strengthening physiques, restoring vitality, healing internal injuries, and granting temporary or permanent attributes depending on the ingredients used]
Dexter blinked.
"...Grandmaster already?"
He stared at the translucent blue screen floating before his eyes. The golden letters gleamed softly.
Before he could react further, another notification appeared.
[Rewards Obtained:]
- Type-II Spirit Cooking Pot
- 50 kg Diamond Rice
Dexter’s eyes widened.
The information flowed into his mind immediately. It arrived like a stream of pure knowledge, filling his understanding without effort.

Diamond Rice was an extremely precious grain nurtured inside high-density mana fields. Every single grain contained pure life essence condensed over months of careful cultivation. The grains absorbed ambient mana from their environment, storing it inside their crystalline structure.
Long-term consumption greatly strengthened the body. Muscles became denser. Bones grew harder. Reflexes sharpened.

Legends even claimed that someone who ate Diamond Rice continuously for an entire year would awaken the legendary Diamond Physique — a body with skin as tough as steel and bones as hard as diamonds. Blades would break against it. Blunt force would barely dent it.
Most people dismissed it as a myth.
Not because it was impossible...
But because no one, not even the wealthiest family in the city could afford enough Diamond Rice for a year. A single kilogram could cost more than most families earned in a year.
Yet inside Dexter’s system inventory...
There was an entire fifty-kilogram bag.
He couldn’t help smiling.
This time, even Mira who usually didn’t finish her food told Dexter to continue feeding her till not even a single grain was left.
As he stood up to clean the dining table, the girls glanced at each other as though in silent communication and didn’t stand to go cultivate.
Dexter frowned and asked. "is there something wrong?"
Mira glanced at the girls then Selene opened her mouth to speak in her tiny voice. "We just want to ask."
Dexter raises an eyebrow as he placed the bowls in the sink. " Ask what?"
"Why?"
Dexter blinked his eyes and asked. "Why what?"

Lyra types something on her phone and a female robotic voice came out. "Why are you doing all of this? Risking your live for us, taking care of us, taking our pain away. Why? What do you gain from it all? No one truly does anything so selfless."

"You are a good person and we all know that. But at this moment, it’s gotten a bit extreme. You risking your lives to save ours and killing those assassins. Not kneingvif you would live or die...its a bit much for us to handle. We haven’t owned anyone such huge a favor."

Legends even claimed that someone who ate Diamond Rice continuously for an entire year would awaken the legendary Diamond Physique — a body with skin as tough as steel and bones as hard as diamonds.
Blades would break against it.
Blunt force would barely dent it.
Most people dismissed it as a myth.
Not because it was impossible...
But because no one, not even the wealthiest family in the city could afford enough Diamond Rice for a year.
A single kilogram could cost more than most families earned in a year.
Yet inside Dexter’s system inventory...
There was an entire fifty-kilogram bag.
He couldn’t help smiling.
This time, even Mira who usually didn’t finish her food told Dexter to continue feeding her till not even a single grain was left.
As he stood up to clean the dining table, the girls glanced at each other as though in silent communication and didn’t stand to go cultivate.
Dexter frowned and asked.
"is there something wrong?"
Mira glanced at the girls then Selene opened her mouth to speak in her tiny voice.
"We just want to ask."
Dexter raises an eyebrow as he placed the bowls in the sink.
" Ask what?"
"Why?"
Dexter blinked his eyes and asked.
"Why what?"
Lyra types something on her phone and a female robotic voice came out.
"Why are you doing all of this?
Risking your live for us, taking care of us, taking our pain away.
Why?
What do you gain from it all?
No one truly does anything so selfless."
"You are a good person and we all know that.
But at this moment, it’s gotten a bit extreme.
You risking your lives to save ours and killing those assassins.
Not kneingvif you would live or die...its a bit much for us to handle.
We haven’t owned anyone such huge a favor."

chapters.title: Chapter 47 | First Level Of Eternal Buddha Endurance Scripture
paragraphs: Mira opened her mouth and she continued. "From what we could discern over the past few days, you’re obviously not from a normal background. If you were lucky enough to come across a 7th tier technique, you could have given any of the Seven main families in the city in exchange for resources and power. But you gave them to us to use instead. Which means you weren’t lucky to come across the technique but was given to you instead by."

Mira’s eyes glinted as she deduced him."It’s obvious you have a mysterious person or even a company backing you. One that is even greater than the seven families combined. We are just confused as to why you still decide to stay with us, playing the perfect husband for his three Crippled Wives."
Mira’s tone changed as she continued dryly
"And don’t tell me you fell in love with one of us."
"You see me naked everyday but never aroused."
The girls blushed slightly when they heard Mira say this so indifferently.
But Mira continued.
"So I know it’s not love nor is it lust that’s making you stay with us but something else entirely."
Dexter froze slightly at Mira’s deduction. The girls were actually smarter than they looked.
He looked at three of them andsmiled. "Do you want your pain back or want to stop cultivating the 7th tier technique? Or do you want me to stop taking care of you three?"
The girls blinked their eyes, they certainly don’t want that. Mira frowned. "That’s not what we’re asking you."

Dexter shrugged and turned around to wash the plates. "I certainly have my reasons for being with you three and rest assured, my intentions are pure. I don’t have plans on leaving you three any time soon. Unless either of you want to leave me, then that’s fine."
He turned back and his expression turned serious. "I promise not to leave you three. Satisfied?"

The three stared at Dexter with various expressions on their faces. While they truly wish to know his intentions, him specifically telling them he would never leave them made thee hearts fluttered and even the indifferent Mira’s felt her belly tickled with butterflies.
Selene squeezed her legs as she stared at Dexter with an expression different from the two girls.
Dexter hadn’t particularly answered their questions but they were quite satisfied.
Mira grunted an unknown word while Selene and Lyra smiled internally as they each head to their favorite position to cultivate.
Dexter was deep in thought. It was true. Without the system, he most likely wouldn’t have cared for them.
But now, he was starting to carw for them even without the system. And the system had become an added bonus reward for him.
That evening, Dexter prepared dinner once more.

He used the new Type-II Spirit Cooking Pot for the first time. The pot was crafted from a dark metal that seemed to absorb light. Its surface was smooth and warm to the touch. When heated, it distributed temperature perfectly across every inch of its interior.
No hot spots. No cold zones. Perfect circulation.
The food cooked faster and more evenly than anything he had prepared before.
The moment he finished cooking...
[Ding!]
[100× Return Activated.]
[Reward Obtained: E-Rank Talent — Alchemist Flame.]
A warm crimson flame suddenly appeared above Dexter’s palm.
It flickered gently like a candle in a quiet room.
Unlike ordinary fire, it emitted no burning heat. It didn’t scorch. It didn’t spread.
Instead, it carried a gentle warmth that perfectly controlled temperature. He could feel the flame responding to his will. Hotter. Cooler. Wider. Narrower. Every adjustment happened instantly.
It was the ideal flame for cooking.
It was also the ideal flame for alchemy.
But that was a thought for another day.
"This will make fodd smithing meals much easier..."
The corners of his lips rose.
He cultivated the entire night but just an hour into the cultivation, his body rumbled as he broke through to the first level of the Eternal Buddha Endurance Scripture.
The Flesh Tempering Realm.
Eternal Buddha Endurance Scripture
A legendary body-refining art that transforms pain into power. Every wound, hardship, poison, and trial endured permanently tempers the body. The greater the suffering, the greater the growth.
First Stage - Flesh Tempering

The practitioner’s body begins to convert pain into vitality. Muscles, tendons, and bones gradually become stronger with every injury, while minor wounds heal faster than before. Fatigue also recovers more quickly, allowing the practitioner to withstand longer battles.
Second Stage - Iron Bones

The skeleton undergoes a complete transformation, becoming as tough as refined steel. Bones are far more difficult to break, and even when fractured, they mend at an astonishing rate. The practitioner’s resistance to pain and ordinary toxins also increases significantly.
Third Stage - Golden Organs

The internal organs are refined into a far more resilient state, making them resistant to internal injuries and disease. The practitioner’s vitality and stamina increase greatly, while regeneration becomes noticeably faster. Most common poisons lose much of their effectiveness.
Fourth Stage - Vajra Flesh

The flesh and skin become incredibly durable, allowing the practitioner to withstand powerful physical attacks with minimal damage. Heat, cold, and harsh environments become easier to endure, while wounds close much faster than those of an ordinary cultivator.
Fifth Stage - Diamond Marrow

The marrow is reborn, producing blood infused with extraordinary vitality. The practitioner’s regenerative abilities improve dramatically, physical endurance reaches an exceptional level, and aging slows considerably. Most poisons become incapable of causing lasting harm.
Sixth Stage - Bodhisattva Heart

The practitioner’s heart and mind become as unshakable as a mountain. Fear, intimidation, and many forms of mental interference lose their effect. Rather than weakening the practitioner, pain sharpens their focus and strengthens their resolve in battle.
Seventh Stage - Eternal Vajra Body

The body reaches a level of resilience where ordinary weapons and techniques struggle to inflict meaningful damage. Even grievous injuries no longer significantly reduce combat ability, and lost flesh or damaged limbs can slowly regenerate over time.
Eighth Stage - Nirvana Rebirth

Every brush with death becomes an opportunity for rebirth. The practitioner recovers from devastating injuries at miraculous speeds, and each recovery permanently strengthens every aspect of the body. Their lifespan expands greatly, and the body continues evolving after every life-threatening ordeal.
Ninth Stage - Eternal Buddha Body

The practitioner’s body ascends beyond mortal limitations, becoming an indestructible vessel tempered through endless suffering. Pain is instantly transformed into overwhelming vitality, regeneration, and strength. The flesh, bones, blood, and even the soul possess extraordinary durability, making the practitioner nearly impossible to kill. As long as they are not completely annihilated, they can recover from almost any injury, and every hardship they endure permanently increases their power without a true limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 | Five Years Cultivation
paragraphs: That night, the small bungalow was unusually quiet.

Dexter had already returned to his room, and the girls had also settled into theirs. The house was no longer the cold, lonely place it had been just a few days ago. Through his newly awakened Enhanced Hearing, he could hear the faint, steady rhythm of breathing coming from the room opposite his own. The three women had entered their nightly cultivation. It was peaceful.
Dexter remained seated on his airbed for a few moments. The mattress shifted slightly under his weight. He took a deep breath, but instead of lying down to sleep, he suddenly stood up.
There was still one very important thing left to do.

He stepped out into the dark hallway. Opposite his room was the girls’ room, its door closed completely shut. He paused and glanced at it briefly. He remembered how helpless they had looked when the Ashford family butler had dumped them here with just an old key and ten thousand dollars. He would not let them be helpless again.
Dexter walked quietly toward the living room and reached into his system’s storage space. A small, magical paper appeared in his hand.
It was the Type-5 House Protection Talisman.

The talisman itself was only the size of his palm. However, it felt heavy with power. It was covered in countless silver runes that glowed faintly, looking like tiny stars trapped beneath the surface of the paper.

Dexter looked around the dim living room for a suitable hiding place. His eyes scanned the old furniture, the peeling wallpaper, and the worn-out floorboards. Eventually, his gaze landed on the decorative rug positioned right beneath the center table.
"Perfect," he whispered to himself.

He carefully lifted the heavy wooden center table and pushed it aside. Then, he folded back the edge of the dusty rug. He placed the glowing talisman flat against the cold floor before covering it up once more. He dragged the table back to its original position, making sure everything looked exactly as it had before.
No one would ever think to look there.
The moment the heavy rug settled back into place—
Buzz!

A faint, warm ripple spread outward from beneath the floorboards. An invisible wave expanded through the living room, rushing through the hallway, and passing through every wall, every window, and every dark corner of the property.
For a brief moment, Dexter felt as though an enormous, transparent glass dome had formed around the entire house. It shimmered in the dark before disappearing completely from sight.
The barrier had activated.

A wide smile appeared on Dexter’s face. With this powerful talisman protecting the house, ordinary street thugs like Kreg and his men would never be able to force their way inside again. Even professional, highly trained assassins would find it nearly impossible to sneak into the bungalow unnoticed.

Not only would the barrier block unauthorized entry, but it would also hide the house from magical detection techniques. Best of all, it would immediately send a warning straight to Dexter’s mind if anyone even tried to breach the perimeter.
For the first time since moving to this broken-down house, he felt completely relieved. He let out a long breath.
"Now they’re safe."

Satisfied with the security, Dexter returned to his small bedroom and closed the wooden door gently behind him. Only then did his thoughts drift toward another mysterious item resting quietly inside his system storage.
The Primordial Beast Egg.

The egg was incredibly ancient. It looked like a stone that had survived for millions of years. Even the all-knowing system itself hadn’t revealed what kind of species it belonged to. Its only instruction had been very simple:
> [Cultivate beside the egg and it will eventually hatch.]
Dexter strongly considered taking it out and gicing the girls to cultivate with because it would be faster to make it hatch with three of them cultivating it but he quickly abandoned the idea.
If the girls saw a massive, glowing egg sitting in the house, they would naturally ask questions. He couldn’t answer those questions without revealing his system.
Instead, a much better idea formed in his mind.
When coming back from the Hero Association, he could pretend to have found it and bought it.
It was a believable excuse for bringing a giant egg into the house first.
His thoughts shifted again. This time, he thought about the Talent Upgrade Cards.
Currently, only Mira’s dormant talent had surfaced. She possessed the Spectral Arm Talent. Using the upgrade card, he could immediately raise her talent from D-Rank up to C-Rank.
Unfortunately, Lyra and Selene’s hidden talents had not yet shown themselves.
There was no point in rushing the upgrade.
He would simply wait until their new abilities surfaced naturally before making his move. Patience was also a form of investment.
His thoughts then drifted to the Five Years of Cultivation Reward
Dexter then turned his attention entirely inward.
His mana affinity had already risen to the legendary SS-Rank. Even now, while he was just standing there without actively cultivating, mana continuously flowed into his body from the surrounding air.
The difference was almost absurd. He remembered his past life clearly. Back when he possessed a trash F-Rank affinity, absorbing mana had been like trying to catch a slippery fish with greasy hands.
Now? It felt as though the entire world itself was pouring a waterfall of mana directly into his veins. The sensation was absolutely intoxicating.

Dexter sat down cross-legged on his soft airbed. His Flame Demon Bloodline had evolved, making his physical body had transformed into something much stronger. His physical strength had increased several times over.
But before checking his status screen to see his new numbers, there was one major reward he wanted to claim first.
The Five Years of Cultivation Reward.

Dexter slowly closed his eyes and entered a deep state of meditation. His breathing slowed down to a steady rhythm. His racing thoughts calmed into a quiet pool. One minute later, after completely entering his focused cultivation state, he spoke quietly into the empty room.
"System."
[Ding!]
"I accept the Five Years Cultivation Reward."
For a brief, agonizing moment—nothing happened.
Then—
BOOM!!

A massive tsunami of pure, liquid mana erupted from deep within his body. It felt as though a gigantic, heavy dam had burst open somewhere inside his chest. Mana flooded every single meridian, every major organ, and every tiny cell in his body.
Surprisingly, there was absolutely no pain. The energy was powerful beyond human imagination, but it was also strangely gentle.

chapters.title: Chapter 49 | Super-Human Hero Breakthrough!
paragraphs: Surprisingly, there was absolutely no pain. The energy was powerful beyond human imagination, but it was also strangely gentle and incredibly warm.
It surged through his body like an endless, glowing river, strengthening everything it touched. His cultivation level began rising rapidly, breaking past his previous limits.
Eleventh Stage...
Twelfth Stage...

He crossed into the Twelfth Stage of the Awakened Realm almost instantly. But the incoming energy didn’t stop there. Instead, it began stabilizing his core and refining his foundation, making it thick and unbreakable.
Initial Twelfth Stage.
Middle Twelfth Stage.
Late Twelfth Stage.
Peak Twelfth Stage.
Peak...
Peak...
Peak...
Eventually—
Crack!
A massive barrier inside his soul shattered into a million pieces.
At that exact moment, Dexter’s conscious mind was pulled away from his physical body. The bedroom vanished, and he found himself standing in a vast, endless universe of absolute darkness.
Yet, within that dark void, floated two brilliant, glowing stars.

These were his Star Nodes. The two Star Nodes he had ignited through the Limitless Grand Cosmos Scripture shone brilliantly, looking like miniature suns burning within an endless, empty universe. Apart from those two bright stars, everything else remained completely empty.
Then, suddenly—
A gigantic structure appeared between the two suns. It resembled an enormous strand of human DNA, but twisted into a cosmic helix.
The massive structure was divided into twelve distinct segments. Each segment was connected to the next while remaining clearly separated.
All twelve segments were gray. Silent. Lifeless. Ancient.
The leftover mana from the five years of cultivation quickly surged into this dark universe and slammed directly into the first segment of the helix.
All twelve segments were currently gray, silent, and lifeless, looking like ancient stone.

Suddenly, a tear opened in the dark space, and the massive pool of mana from his five years of cultivation poured into this inner universe. A strong pull came from the first gray segment of the helix, sucking the colorful mana inside.
"WENG!"
A vibrant, rainbow-colored light flared at the base of the first segment. The dead, gray outer shell began to crack and crumble away, revealing a beautiful, glowing energy beneath.
The light spread rapidly.
Ten percent.
Twenty percent.
Fifty percent.
Eighty percent.
Until finally—
The entire first segment exploded with dazzling, blinding radiance. The dead gray shell shattered completely, revealing the pure power underneath.

Then, something totally unexpected happened. From the bottom end of the first segment, countless multicolored tendrils emerged. They looked like living tree roots, or glowing cosmic tentacles. They stretched outward through the empty space and attached themselves tightly to the second segment.
The moment the connection formed, energy began flowing rapidly.

The second segment lit up in a flash. Gray turned into bright light. Decay turned into vibrant life. The second segment awakened completely. More glowing tendrils erupted from its end. They quickly connected to the third segment.
The process repeated itself. The third segment slowly began to awaken.
Ten percent.
Twenty percent.
Thirty percent.
Until finally, the energy stopped completely.
The third segment had only been partially activated. The massive power of the five years of cultivation had finally been exhausted. Complete silence returned to the cosmic darkness.

Then Dexter opened his real eyes. Golden light flashed brightly through his pupils. Raw power surged aggressively through every inch of his physical body. He slowly clenched his right fist, feeling the air pop around his knuckles.
Finally... he had reached the Superhuman Realm.

Never in his miserable life, when he was treated like a slave by his family, had he imagined reaching this incredible level. Yet, not only had he broken through—he had directly entered the Third Stage of the Superhuman Realm.

The difference between the lower Awakened Realm and the Superhuman Realm was simply overwhelming. Mana flowed through his veins effortlessly, like blood. His muscles had become much denser and heavier. His bones were stronger than steel. Even his skin cells seemed to contain endless, buzzing vitality.
Without even activating his Enhanced Hearing Talent, he could already hear the soft sounds of insects moving within a hundred-meter radius.
His eyesight had sharpened tremendously. Colors appeared brighter, clearer, and much more vibrant.

Even without using his mana to enhance his vision, he could perfectly see a tiny, brown ant crawling along a tiny crack in the far wall. He could distinguish individual, microscopic grains of dust floating slowly through the bedroom air.
It felt as though the entire world had been upgraded to high definition. Everything was more detailed. More alive.
Dexter couldn’t stop smiling.

If he encountered that same Fifth Stage Superhuman assassin from the bridge again—he was absolutely confident he could kill the man with a single, casual strike. No wonder the battle had been so difficult before.
The gap in power between major realms was simply too large. If his current self fought ten versions of his former self... he could probably kill all ten of them within three seconds.
That was the terrifying difference a major realm represented.
Dexter inhaled deeply to calm his racing heart before speaking aloud.
"System. Open Status."
10,000x INVESTMENT MULTIPLIER SYSTEM
[Name]: Dexter Ashford

[Bloodline]
Ancient Flame Demon Bloodline (Ancient Grade)
Dexter leaned his head back slightly against the hard headboard, a deeply satisfied smile appearing on his face.

Although his official cultivation level had only reached the Third Stage of the Superhuman Realm, his actual, raw combat strength was far, far beyond that. According to his own rough estimation, his base physical combat power alone was already perfectly comparable to a Sixth Stage Superhuman Hero.

And if he truly went all out in a fight... if he unleashed his demonic bloodline abilities, his magical talents, and his martial techniques all simultaneously... he could probably fight evenly against Eighth Stage or even Ninth Stage Superhuman Heroes.
The thought alone made his heart race with excitement.

For the very first time in his entire life, he finally possessed enough personal strength to stand proudly on his own two feet, instead of hiding in fear behind others. He no longer needed to lower his head in shame or fear. He no longer needed to watch helplessly as rich families bullied him or the innocent people around him.
He had finally gained the absolute power to protect his new family.

sentences.text: Surprisingly, there was absolutely no pain.
The energy was powerful beyond human imagination, but it was also strangely gentle and incredibly warm.
It surged through his body like an endless, glowing river, strengthening everything it touched.
His cultivation level began rising rapidly, breaking past his previous limits.
Eleventh Stage...
Twelfth Stage...
He crossed into the Twelfth Stage of the Awakened Realm almost instantly.
But the incoming energy didn’t stop there.
Instead, it began stabilizing his core and refining his foundation, making it thick and unbreakable.
Initial Twelfth Stage.
Middle Twelfth Stage.
Late Twelfth Stage.
Peak Twelfth Stage.
Peak...
Peak...
Peak...
Eventually—
Crack!
A massive barrier inside his soul shattered into a million pieces.
At that exact moment, Dexter’s conscious mind was pulled away from his physical body.
The bedroom vanished, and he found himself standing in a vast, endless universe of absolute darkness.
Yet, within that dark void, floated two brilliant, glowing stars.
These were his Star Nodes.
The two Star Nodes he had ignited through the Limitless Grand Cosmos Scripture shone brilliantly, looking like miniature suns burning within an endless, empty universe.
Apart from those two bright stars, everything else remained completely empty.
Then, suddenly—
A gigantic structure appeared between the two suns.
It resembled an enormous strand of human DNA, but twisted into a cosmic helix.
The massive structure was divided into twelve distinct segments.
Each segment was connected to the next while remaining clearly separated.
All twelve segments were gray.
Silent.
Lifeless.
Ancient.
The leftover mana from the five years of cultivation quickly surged into this dark universe and slammed directly into the first segment of the helix.
All twelve segments were currently gray, silent, and lifeless, looking like ancient stone.
Suddenly, a tear opened in the dark space, and the massive pool of mana from his five years of cultivation poured into this inner universe.
A strong pull came from the first gray segment of the helix, sucking the colorful mana inside.
"WENG!"
A vibrant, rainbow-colored light flared at the base of the first segment.
The dead, gray outer shell began to crack and crumble away, revealing a beautiful, glowing energy beneath.
The light spread rapidly.
Ten percent.
Twenty percent.
Fifty percent.
Eighty percent.
Until finally—
The entire first segment exploded with dazzling, blinding radiance.
The dead gray shell shattered completely, revealing the pure power underneath.
Then, something totally unexpected happened.
From the bottom end of the first segment, countless multicolored tendrils emerged.
They looked like living tree roots, or glowing cosmic tentacles.
They stretched outward through the empty space and attached themselves tightly to the second segment.
The moment the connection formed, energy began flowing rapidly.
The second segment lit up in a flash.
Gray turned into bright light.
Decay turned into vibrant life.
The second segment awakened completely.
More glowing tendrils erupted from its end.
They quickly connected to the third segment.
The process repeated itself.
The third segment slowly began to awaken.
Ten percent.
Twenty percent.
Thirty percent.
Until finally, the energy stopped completely.
The third segment had only been partially activated.
The massive power of the five years of cultivation had finally been exhausted.
Complete silence returned to the cosmic darkness.
Then Dexter opened his real eyes.
Golden light flashed brightly through his pupils.
Raw power surged aggressively through every inch of his physical body.
He slowly clenched his right fist, feeling the air pop around his knuckles.
Finally... he had reached the Superhuman Realm.
Never in his miserable life, when he was treated like a slave by his family, had he imagined reaching this incredible level.
Yet, not only had he broken through—he had directly entered the Third Stage of the Superhuman Realm.
The difference between the lower Awakened Realm and the Superhuman Realm was simply overwhelming.
Mana flowed through his veins effortlessly, like blood.
His muscles had become much denser and heavier.
His bones were stronger than steel.
Even his skin cells seemed to contain endless, buzzing vitality.
Without even activating his Enhanced Hearing Talent, he could already hear the soft sounds of insects moving within a hundred-meter radius.
His eyesight had sharpened tremendously.
Colors appeared brighter, clearer, and much more vibrant.
Even without using his mana to enhance his vision, he could perfectly see a tiny, brown ant crawling along a tiny crack in the far wall.
He could distinguish individual, microscopic grains of dust floating slowly through the bedroom air.
It felt as though the entire world had been upgraded to high definition.
Everything was more detailed.
More alive.
Dexter couldn’t stop smiling.
If he encountered that same Fifth Stage Superhuman assassin from the bridge again—he was absolutely confident he could kill the man with a single, casual strike.
No wonder the battle had been so difficult before.
The gap in power between major realms was simply too large.
If his current self fought ten versions of his former self... he could probably kill all ten of them within three seconds.
That was the terrifying difference a major realm represented.
Dexter inhaled deeply to calm his racing heart before speaking aloud.
"System.
Open Status."
10,000x INVESTMENT MULTIPLIER SYSTEM
